description: Source code for PromptManager class and related functionality for loading, parsing, rendering, and managing prompt templates following Google's Dotprompt specification, including YAML frontmatter parsing and Jinja2 templating.

classes.name: PromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a single prompt template with metadata and content, including extraction of metadata fields.

classes.name: PromptManager
classes.description: Manages loading, parsing, rendering, and managing prompt templates following the Dotprompt specification, supporting YAML frontmatter and Jinja2 templating.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes PromptManager, optionally loading prompts from directory, file, or JSON data.

methods.name: _load_prompts
methods.description: Loads all .prompt files from the specified directory.

methods.name: _load_prompts_from_json
methods.description: Loads prompts from provided JSON data structure.

methods.name: _load_prompt_file
methods.description: Loads and parses a single .prompt file into a PromptTemplate.

methods.name: _parse_frontmatter
methods.description: Parses YAML frontmatter from prompt content.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a prompt template with given variables, optionally validating input schema.

methods.name: _validate_input
methods.description: Performs basic validation of input variables against schema.

methods.name: _get_python_type
methods.description: Converts schema type string to Python type.

methods.name: get_prompt
methods.description: Retrieves a prompt template by ID and optional version.

methods.name: list_prompts
methods.description: Returns list of all prompt IDs.

methods.name: get_prompt_metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata for a specific prompt.

methods.name: reload_prompts
methods.description: Reloads all prompts from the directory.

methods.name: prompt_file_to_json
methods.description: Converts a .prompt file to JSON format.

methods.name: json_to_prompt_file
methods.description: Converts JSON prompt data to .prompt file format.

methods.name: get_all_prompts_as_json
methods.description: Returns all prompts in JSON format.

methods.name: load_prompts_from_json_data
methods.description: Loads additional prompts from JSON data.
